inputs.text: A graduation ceremony in Jaipur has sparked controversy after a student protested administrative issues while receiving her degree. Her remarks in front of the Deputy Chief Minister went viral, drawing mixed reactions: some see her actions as a brave stand for student rights, while others say it was inappropriate for the occasion. The incident has renewed discussion about challenges students face in educational institutions. The university administration has remained silent, and the event is still a hot topic.
